title: Adic systems of finite modules over a complete discrete valuation ring
statement:
Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].

1. Let $(M_n)_{n\geq1}$ be an inverse system in which $M_n$ is a finite $A_{E,n}$-module and the transition map $M_{n+1}\to M_n$ induces an isomorphism $M_{n+1}\otimes_{A_{E,n+1}}A_{E,n}=M_{n+1}/\varpi_E^nM_{n+1}\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n$. Then $M=\varprojlim_nM_n$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-module, the projections induce isomorphisms $M/\varpi_E^nM\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n$, and the inverse-limit topology on $M$ (each $M_n$ discrete) is the $\mathfrak m_E$-adic topology.
2. Conversely every finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-module $M$ is $\mathfrak m_E$-adically complete and separated, $M\to\varprojlim_nM/\varpi_E^nM$ is an isomorphism, and $(M/\varpi_E^nM)_n$ is a system as in (1). Every $\mathcal O_E$-linear map between finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-modules is continuous for the $\mathfrak m_E$-adic topologies, and for finitely generated $M,N$ the reductions give a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_E}(M,N)\to\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Hom}_{A_{E,n}}(M/\varpi_E^nM,N/\varpi_E^nN)$.
3. For finitely generated $M,N$ and a finite extension $L/E$, $(M\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}N)/\varpi_E^n\cong M/\varpi_E^nM\otimes_{A_{E,n}}N/\varpi_E^nN$ and $(M\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)/\varpi_E^n\cong M/\varpi_E^nM\otimes_{A_{E,n}}\mathcal O_L/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_L$, compatibly with $n$.

source.place: Lemma 09B8 (algebra, lemma-limit-complete: M = lim M_n with M_n = M_{n+1}/I^n M_{n+1} has M/I^nM = M_n and is I-adically complete); Lemma 031D (algebra, lemma-finite-over-complete-ring: finiteness from M/IM finite over a complete ring); Lemma 00MA (algebra, lemma-completion-tensor: finite modules over a Noetherian ring, M^ = M tensor R^, so finite modules over a complete Noetherian ring are complete); part (3) is right exactness of the tensor product

proof.text: Apply the adic-tower reconstruction lemma to A=O_E and the finitely generated principal ideal I=(varpi_E). It gives M/varpi_E^n M isomorphic to M_n for every n, identifies the inverse-limit topology with the varpi_E-adic topology, and in particular makes M separated.

The coefficient-extension completeness result gives that E is complete. A Cauchy sequence in O_E is therefore convergent in E, and its limit remains in O_E because O_E is the closed unit ball for the nonarchimedean absolute value; hence O_E is complete for the varpi_E-adic topology, which is the m_E-adic topology for a uniformizer. Since M/varpi_E M is the finite A_{E,1}-module M_1 and M is separated by Step 1, Lemma 031D applies and shows M is finitely generated over O_E.

Conversely, for finitely generated M, O_E is Noetherian because it is a discrete valuation ring, and it is complete for (varpi_E) by the argument in Step 2. The finite-module-completeness lemma therefore gives M isomorphic to lim_n M/varpi_E^n M. The canonical quotient maps induce the required isomorphisms between successive reductions, so this is a system as in (1), and M is complete and separated.

An O_E-linear map f:M\to N satisfies f(varpi_E^n M) \subseteq varpi_E^n N, so it is continuous for the varpi_E-adic (= m_E-adic) topologies and induces reductions f_n: M/varpi_E^nM \to N/varpi_E^nN, compatible in n. By Step 3, O_E is Noetherian and varpi_E-adically complete, so the finite-module-completeness lemma applied to the finitely generated N (R=O_E, J=(varpi_E)) shows that N \to lim_n N/varpi_E^nN is bijective. Injectivity: if all f_n vanish then f(M) lies in the kernel of this map, so f=0. Surjectivity: a compatible family (g_n) gives the O_E-linear map M \to lim_n N/varpi_E^nN, x \mapsto (g_n(x mod varpi_E^nM))_n, which composed with the inverse of the bijection is an O_E-linear g:M\to N whose reductions are the g_n. This is the displayed bijection.
Right exactness of tensor products applied to O_E \to A_{E,n} gives (M tensor_{O_E} N)/varpi_E^n(M tensor N) isomorphic to (M/varpi_E^nM) tensor_{A_{E,n}} (N/varpi_E^nN), compatibly with n.

source.place: right exactness of tensor product; Lemma 00MA (lemma-completion-tensor), quotient description

proof.text: The same right-exact tensor argument for the O_E-algebra O_L gives (M tensor_{O_E} O_L)/varpi_E^n(M tensor O_L) isomorphic to (M/varpi_E^nM) tensor_{A_{E,n}} (O_L/varpi_E^n O_L), compatibly with n.

lean.note: The four declarations jointly state parts (1), (2), and the two identities of (3). Positive levels are indexed by n + 1. Coefficient modules in (1) are represented as valuation-ring modules annihilated by the corresponding coefficient ideal; canonical quotient isomorphisms are rendered by surjectivity and the exact kernel.
